context.transcript:
Attention passengers, the 10 o'clock ferry to Backshare Island is delayed one hour because of unexpected construction at the destination port.
We apologize for any inconvenience this delay might cause you.
Passengers who show their boarding pass to the ticket agent will receive a complimentary food voucher to be used at any of the restaurants in the food court.
And just a reminder to all passengers, please follow all posted safety procedures while on the dock and aboard the boat.
Failure to do so will result in a fine.
context.transcript_translation:
乘客们请注意，开往 Backshare Island 的十点渡轮因目的地港口意外施工而延误一小时。
对于此次延误给您带来的不便，我们深表歉意。
向售票员出示登船证的乘客可以在美食广场任何一家餐厅领取免费食品券。
另外提醒所有乘客，在码头和船上请遵守所有张贴的安全程序。
否则将面临罚款。
